verdict.rationale: The CUDA Toolkit docs confirm NVIDIA ships a full GPU-compute developer toolchain (compiler, libraries, Nsight profiling tools, CUDA Tile C++/Python) that targets GeForce RTX GPUs generally, and RTX 50-series pages reference PyTorch/Ollama/Windows ML inference support, but no citation explicitly names the RTX 5080 as a supported CUDA compute-capability target. missing for 10: an explicit RTX 5080 CUDA compute-capability/supported-GPU list entry, independent developer confirmation of CUDA workloads running on this specific SKU.
